name: k6
summary: Load and performance testing with scripts in JavaScript or TypeScript, thresholds as pass/fail criteria and a CLI that fits CI.
strengths: Thresholds turn performance budgets into CI gates.
Scripts are code, reviewed and versioned with the app.
Efficient load generation from a single machine.
tradeoffs: Scripts are JavaScript or TypeScript regardless of your app language.
Browser-level performance needs its separate browser module.
